title: Vintage Le Creuset Enameled Cast Iron Grill Pan – Red
description:
High-quality Le Creuset grill pan made from enameled cast iron, perfect for grilling meat, fish, and vegetables. The black matte interior ensures excellent searing, while the cast iron provides even heat distribution and long-lasting heat retention for optimal cooking results.
Made from durable enameled cast iron
Black matte interior for perfect grilling and browning
Heats evenly and retains heat efficiently
Ideal for low-fat cooking at high or medium temperatures
Compatible with all heat sources, including induction, oven, grill, and barbecue
Easy to use and clean, dishwasher safe
As with all my items, this is a vintage piece and shows signs of use consistent with age. Please refer to the photos for condition details.
